decision.explanation: The sources present two distinct claims regarding the establishment date of Altrincham Grammar School. Document 1 (D1S4) and Document 2 (D2S4) state the school was founded as 'Altrincham County High School for Boys' in 1912. Document 3 (D3S8) explicitly lists 'Established: 1850' in an infobox, and Document 4 (D4S2) categorizes the institution under 'Educational institutions established in 1850'. As the prompt requires preserving all supported alternate referents and resolving the exact relation without inventing restrictions to favor one over the other, both 1912 and 1850 are returned as valid answers derived from the provided text.
